---
name: Report a confusing lesson
about: A lesson's written explanation, takeaways, or check questions didn't click
title: "[Lesson] "
labels: content
---

**Which lesson?**
Path or link, e.g. `roadmaps/ai-engineer/lessons/bias-and-fairness.md`.

**What didn't click?**
Be specific: which section, which claim, which check question — and what made it confusing (wrong, unclear, assumes knowledge you didn't have, etc.).

**What would have helped?**
If you have a better way to explain it, include it here.
